entries.title: Would this community prefer to be under the radar?
entries.author: techcrunch
entries.current_title: Would this community prefer to be under the radar?
entries.excerpt: I've been getting a lot of private and public feedback suggesting I stop posting about Hacker News on TechCrunch because it's polluting the community. Do you guys think I'm hurting the site, not helping?
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者询问 TechCrunch 的曝光是否会伤害 HN 社区。

entries.title: Ask YC: Dealing with post startup depression
entries.author: poststartup
entries.current_title: Ask YC: Dealing with post startup depression
entries.excerpt: Hi, I recently shut down my first startup ever. I am having a really tough time getting over it and starting all over again. A feeling of extreme weakness and failure has taken all over me , clouding my judgement. Any tips on getting back to normalcy would be highly appreciated.
entries.guide_zh: 首次创业关停后陷入失落，作者求助如何走出失败阴影。

entries.title: Come stay at the hacker house in San Jose, Free

entries.guide_zh: 两位创业者搬到圣何塞，邀请其他黑客免费住进空余房间。

entries.title: Ask Hacker News: Cost of living in Silicon Valley
entries.author: Prrometheus
entries.current_title: Ask Hacker News: Cost of living in Silicon Valley
entries.excerpt: I’m trying to get a feel for what a single person’s burn rate would be in the valley. I know the cost of living there is supposed to be among the highest in the US. What can someone in Silicon Valley expect to pay each month in rent, food, utilities, car insurance, and gas?
entries.guide_zh: 单身人士在硅谷每月要花多少钱，房租和生活开支如何估算？

entries.title: Ask: What would you do/make if you never had to monetize it?
entries.author: icky
entries.current_title: Ask: What would you do/make if you never had to monetize it?
entries.excerpt: What crazy, wonderful ideas would you implement if your income came from a different source (such as a day job), and, as such, you simply wanted to make things people want, but didn't have the pressure to monetize?
entries.guide_zh: 如果收入已有保障、不必变现，你最想做什么产品或项目？

entries.title: Ask PG: What's the traffic effect here from the TechCrunch mention?
entries.author: robg
entries.current_title: Ask PG: What's the traffic effect here from the TechCrunch mention?
entries.excerpt: Would you mind quantifying some numbers based on the TC front page treatment - before and after? Pageviews? New users? Submissions? Comments? Anything else interesting?
entries.guide_zh: 询问登上 TechCrunch 后，HN 的流量、用户与投稿发生了什么变化。

entries.guide_zh: 借《千钧一发》的台词，作者谈创业时全力投入的心态。

entries.title: Ask YC: Who's your favorite domain registrar and why?
entries.author: pius
entries.current_title: Ask YC: Who's your favorite domain registrar and why?
entries.excerpt: Recently I've been hearing my registrar (GoDaddy.com) getting slammed for domain stealing and other horrors. Though I've never been affected, I figure it's a good idea to become knowledgeable about other best-in-breed services. Can anyone recommend other domain registrars that are great for managing large numbers of domains?
entries.guide_zh: 寻找适合管理大量域名的注册商，并希望了解推荐理由。

entries.title: Ask YC: What would you put on a hacker's bookshelf?
entries.author: Sam_Odio
entries.current_title: Ask YC: What would you put on a hacker's bookshelf?
entries.excerpt: I'll start it off: - O'Reilly's Python in a Nutshell - A 12" PB (I use my old PB as a more capable "kimble" and for quick SSHing into my servers) - And to preempt the half-dozen comments suggesting them: Founders at Work & Hackers and Painters
entries.guide_zh: 一本书、一台旧电脑：邀请大家列出黑客书架上的必备物品。
